description: This file defines the internal class 'RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector' which implements the 'IPlacementFilterDirector' interface. It provides filtering logic for silos based on matching metadata keys and values, used in Orleans runtime placement strategies.

classes.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector
classes.description: Implements placement filtering based on matching silo metadata keys and values.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters a collection of silos based on metadata matching strategy.

methods.name: DoesMetadataMatch
methods.description: Checks if local metadata matches remote silo metadata for specified keys.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Extracts metadata values for specified keys from a silo metadata object.
